scope: Read-only native30-city deployment data. No ROM code, emulator state, UI gameplay proof or runtime115-city binding is included.

direction_semantics.neighbor_key: target original city adjacency row searched for source original city index
direction_semantics.attackers: physical16:9E62 matched-neighbor byte selects target-local edge zone0..3
direction_semantics.defenders: physical17:9AB4 matched-neighbor byte selects target-local central zone0..1
direction_semantics.missing_neighbor_policy: The original falls back to local zone0. A remake should explicitly label a source with no native adjacency instead of pretending that zone0 proves its historical direction.

side_identity.warning: The recovered first_side/second_side names describe array order, not who attacks first.

coordinate_policy.visible_y: packed_y if packed_y<15 else packed_y-1; reject packed_y15 and values outside0..19
coordinate_policy.native_default_predicate: C3CB scans ordered pairs for the first position not occupied by any of20 slots; it does not call C447 or filter terrain.
coordinate_policy.terrain: Water and mountain are not forbidden deployment classes; native default points actually use both.
coordinate_policy.proposed_remake_filter: Keep original evidence unchanged; select unique original points inside both the native rectangle and current visible grid. All91 attacker and53 defender zones retain at least10 candidates.

validation_scope.kind: controlled lifted-function checks, not natural gameplay
validation_scope.note: These recorded counts were verified against the archived lifted source. --check independently re-derives every shipped city/zone from pinned data bytes; it does not claim to rerun the unavailable archive in CI.

proposed_regional_fallback.exact_case: If source/target native template indices form an actual native adjacent pair, use its paired local zones; regional template reuse must still be labeled as remake association.
proposed_regional_fallback.expanded_case: Otherwise compute the target-to-previous-route-point vector from the final strategic route leg: this points outward toward where the attacking army came from, not along its forward travel direction. Choose the native attacker edge rectangle whose camp-to-center vector has the smallest angle to that arrival vector; among duplicate rectangles choose the smallest native neighbor index, and use that neighbor record to pair the defender central zone.
proposed_regional_fallback.missing_geometry: If no nonzero arrival vector is available, choose the smallest native neighbor index deterministically and disclose no-arrival-geometry fallback.
proposed_regional_fallback.legality: Player and AI use the same visible-grid, rectangle and occupancy checks; use the proposed unique-point filter rather than silently editing the source tables. Placement costs no tactical AP and draws no RNG.
proposed_regional_fallback.saves: Only new battles receive arrival-aware initial placement. Loading existing positions/AP must never redeploy or refill points.
